Bipedal_Theropod_Chassis.description: An aggressive, forward-leaning bipedal frame balanced entirely by a massive counter-weight tail. Stripped of heavy forelimb musculature, this chassis is a perfectly optimized biological pursuit engine.

Quadrupedal_Squamate_Core.description: A sprawling, low-to-the-ground frame with limbs splayed outwards rather than directly underneath. Excellent for navigating dense underbrush, crevices, and maintaining absolute stability.

Apodal_Constrictor_Frame.description: An incredibly elongated sequence of heavily muscled vertebrae. Devoid of any traditional limbs, movement is achieved through complex lateral undulation and rectilinear creeping, granting peerless flexibility.
